2608.03930.title: Logic Before Language: Pre-pretraining on Formal Derivations Fosters Skill Acquisition and Compressibility
2608.03930.paper_summary: Pre-pretraining language models (LMs) on symbolic data can accelerate and improve natural language acquisition. However, existing pre-pretraining tasks, such as Dyck and procedural algorithms, rely on narrow primitives that fail to capture the expressive capacity of natural language. Moreover, prior studies remain restricted to relatively small token budgets, offering limited insight into skill emergence and representational dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose logic pre-pretraining (Logic-PPT) as a principled initialization strategy, leveraging formal derivations to impart richer structural and linguistic biases. Formal derivations require abstract mechanisms that are central to natural language, simultaneously binding variables, connecting quantifiers and relational dependencies, and composing predicate-argument structures over long contexts. Scaling our evaluation to a 100B-token regime, logic pre-pretraining substantially accelerates skill acquisition in LMs, achieving 80\% accuracy on linguistic tasks with 36B fewer tokens than standard initialization, and outperforming alternative pre-pretraining baselines. Mechanistically, formal derivations induce persistent structural reorganization, distinctively characterized by a lower-rank, spectrally concentrated representation space. Crucially, we show that this internal geometry enables improved model compressibility via pruning, matching the dense baseline performance even at $\approx$33\% sparsity.
2608.03930.paper_summary_zh: 預訓練語言模型（LMs）在符號數據上的預訓練可以加速並改善自然語言的獲取。<lb/>然而，現有的預訓練任務，如Dyck和程序算法，依賴於狹隘的原始元素，無法捕捉自然語言的表達能力。<lb/>此外，先前的研究仍然限制在相對較小的標記預算內，對技能出現和表徵動態提供的見解有限。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出邏輯預訓練（Logic-PPT）作為一種原則性的初始化策略，利用形式推導來賦予更豐富的結構和語言偏見。<lb/>形式推導需要抽象機制，這些機制是自然語言的核心，能夠同時綁定變量、連接量詞和關係依賴，並在長上下文中組合謂詞-論元結構。<lb/>將我們的評估擴展到100B標記的範疇，邏輯預訓練顯著加速了LMs中的技能獲取，在語言任務上達到80\%的準確率，並比標準初始化少使用了36B的標記，超越了其他預訓練基準。<lb/>在機制上，形式推導引發持久的結構重組，其特徵是較低階、光譜集中表示空間。<lb/>關鍵的是，我們顯示這種內部幾何結構通過修剪提高了模型的可壓縮性，即使在約33\%的稀疏性下也能匹配密集基準的性能。
